external_inputs: [27] Yao 1977, finite minimax in query form (von Neumann minimax for a finite matrix game)

inspection.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq κ] {f : QuarticQuery.PartialBool κ} {L : ℕ},
  ¬QuarticQuery.RLe f L →
    ∃ μ,
      (∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput κ), 0 ≤ μ x) ∧
        ∑ x, μ x = 1 ∧
          (∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput κ), μ x ≠ 0 → QuarticQuery.promised f x) ∧
            ∀ (T : QuarticQuery.QueryTree κ), T.depth ≤ L → QuarticQuery.treeSuccess f μ T ≤ 2 / 3

lean.note: Constructs normalized nonnegative promise-supported μ bounding success of every depth-L tree by 2/3. Normalization also forces a nonempty promise; h is a premise from the lemma, not an additional conjecture.

ledger_history.earlier_ledger_wording: If 1<=L<R(P), there is a distribution mu on dom P such that every deterministic tree of depth <=L has success probability <=2/3 under mu. Consequently the guess of r independent answers succeeds with probability <=(2/3)^r.

statement: If L<R(P), there is a distribution mu on dom P, which is in particular nonempty, such that every deterministic tree of depth <=L has success probability <=2/3 under mu.
